d:
In this video, we contrast the fictional portrayal of underworld don Dawood Ibrahim in Aditya Dhar's film Dhurandhar with explosive real-life revelations made by former FBI operative Kamran Faridi. While the film depicts Dawood as bedridden and incapacitated, Faridi claims the 70-year-old gangster known in Pakistani security circles as 'Bade Saab' actively runs his drug and hawala network from a heavily guarded mansion in Karachi's Clifton area.
